subject.title: Backup: add encrypted snapshot backup flow

question: Should OpenClaw core accept this folder-backed encrypted snapshot backup contract now, or keep core limited to archive export/verify while narrower backup work continues separately?
rationale: The PR adds a persistent core backup config, encrypted snapshot storage, workspace mirroring, and full-host restore semantics that affect credentials and state recovery, so automation cannot choose the permanent product/security boundary.

options.title: Repair and keep in core
options.body: Accept the core backup direction, then require the safety fixes, branch refresh, upgrade proof, and real CLI proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the core surface
options.body: Keep archive export/verify in core and split encrypted folder snapshots or workspace mirroring into a smaller follow-up with explicit owner approval.

options.title: Pause or close this branch
options.body: Close or pause the current broad branch if maintainers prefer a replacement PR with a smaller restore/security scope.

recommendation.title: Repair and keep in core
recommendation.body: Accept the core backup direction, then require the safety fixes, branch refresh, upgrade proof, and real CLI proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent backup docs/test ownership makes this the best available routing signal for the core backup contract decision.
